title: mentha aquatica subsp. crispa
intro: Mentha aquatica subsp. crispa, commonly known as watermint or apple mint, is a subspecies of the water mint plant, characterized by its distinctive crisped leaves. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce nausea and vomiting, and exhibit anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Mentha aquatica subsp. crispa include its use as a carminative, an antispasmodic, and an antioxidant, providing relief from gastrointestinal issues and other health concerns. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, specifically menthone and limonene, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
